The product was derivatized with trifluoroacetic anhydride in the presence of Et3N and analyzed by GC on a chiral β-Dex 325 capillary column (30 m x 0.25 mm). Commercially available chiral 2-amino-1-phenylethanols were also derivatized with trifluoroacetic anhydride and analyzed by GC as comparative samples. THF was removed on a rotary evaporator; then EtOAc (30 mL) and NaCl (5 g) were added to the residue, and the mixture was basified with aq 10% NaOH to pH 12 and stirred for 5 min.
